title: Unit Event — MORE MORE Making Christmas — Episode3 Fan Mail

meta.Event Outline: Following the success of the elementary school event, the girls start planning for another show in real life, but encounter various obstacles along the way. Just when things seem difficult, they receive an email from a fan offering to help. Minori is thrilled, but...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Dear MORE MORE JUMP!
My name is Ayaka Saito. I'm an avid fan of your channel and your streams!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I apologize if this seems rather sudden.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <But I am writing to you today regarding the idea of your group doing a show in real life that came up during your last stream, and I believe that I may be able to help you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Help us...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I am currently a university student who works part-time as a production staff member.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <My line of work has me interacting with various different idol groups and artists on a regular basis...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <As such, I also have experience working with freelancers who do not belong to any agencies and putting on events for them.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Freelancers of this sort usually do not have a manager or staff around them, which makes it difficult for them to put on any events by themselves.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Real-life events always involve some kind of equipment and personnel to handle them.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And I am under the impression that your group will inevitably face certain difficulties in terms of putting on an actual event.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <That is where I come in. Would you be willing to allow me to help you gather staff and find a suitable venue as part of helping you put on this event.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <This will purely be volunteer work as well. Quite a few of my friends are also MORE MORE JUMP! fans, so I believe I'll have more than enough hands on board for this.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold on... This person's serious about helping us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah! It sure sounds like it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, this sounds too good to be true. What if it's really just someone posing as one of our fans? We need to take this into careful consideration...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. But let's keep reading for now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And please feel free to disregard this email if you are not having any trouble with your event.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <However, if you are in a position of requiring outside help, I would be more than happy to be of assistance. I solemnly swear to do my absolute best!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry about the long explanation, but I'm really, genuinely looking forward to your event!
Sincerely, Ayaka Saito>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <P.S. My friends and I at the MMJ fan club that I'm running have written up a prospective plan for your event. We hope you take a look at it.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
An MMJ fan club?!
We have a fan club...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm just as surprised. I had no idea. Is that everything, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... No, there's more.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <P.P.S. In my humble opinion, your best stream so far is the one where you all brought different ingredients and had hot pot together.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I didn't expect it to start with veggies and end with roasting marshmallows. I tried roasting some myself after that and really like it. I hope you do another stream like that in the future...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It certainly sounds like she saw that stream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, my guess is that she's really a fan of ours.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This is so incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Who would've guessed that someone like this would show up to save us like this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mind showing me the attachment this person sent, Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This proposal looks professional...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She and her friends have covered everything from an overall concept, our target audience, a budget and pricing options. They even came up with a few venue layouts...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She said that they work part-time for a production company, but I would've thought that this is her full-time job.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Not only that, she's been paying close attention to us. There's even a part about the best way to showcase ourselves...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This person might just be able to help us give our fans the show they deserve.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And she's willing to write this off as volunteer work without us even asking...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't believe someone's willing to help us like this! Now, our event might just...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is this the right way to go?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want us to spread hope to our fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm wondering if we'd be accomplishing that by relying on them for help. Something about that doesn't sit well with me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wait, what do you mean?
What's so wrong about that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm talking about how I feel the other side of the stage is “reality”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Reality...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. The dazzling stage that brings a dreamlike world to life is only made possible by having staff there to actually make it a reality.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And they have to work incredibly hard. They're the ones who move all the heavy equipment, set everything up and move around thousands of people at a time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By agreeing to have this person help us, we'd be making them “work” instead of having fun, no...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In other words, we'd be forcing our fans to face reality and see what goes on behind the scenes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But she said she works part-time for a production company and has helped put on events before...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That doesn't give us license to say yes to this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to do everything in my power to make sure our fans get to enjoy our events as fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. I get what you're trying to say, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Something about having our fans see the other side of the stage while we try to spread hope from that stage does seem a bit off.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're saying that you want our fans to keep seeing us the way we appear under the spotlight, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, because I'm worried that making them work like this will in turn lead them to not enjoy what we do as fans.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As fans...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But this person...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, this person's offer is almost too good to pass up. Not only do they have experience doing this, she's willing to work pro bono.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I understand that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If it means satisfying the demands of those who want to see us perform live, then we should agree to this offer...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it still means showing them the other side...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like some more time to think about this. If possible, I want to find a different solution...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
I'll try coming up with some ideas too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For now, I'll reply by saying thank you and that we need some time to think about it while we take their offer into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After that, let's try to decide what's best for us, alright?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, but we'll need to act fast since the holidays are right around the corner... Let's do our best to find the best way to go about this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What should we do...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I understand what Haruka means by not wanting to have our fans see what goes on behind the scenes...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Asking our fans to work as staff means that they probably won't get to enjoy this event as actual fans...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Still...)
Outdoor Stage

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hehe♪ The ASRUN meet and greet's today!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I can't wait to meet Haruka.
It's outside today too, so I'll get to see her under this beautiful, blue sky...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wah!
I-It's so windy...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Is there a typhoon coming?
Oh, I should put my ticket back in my bag!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Hey, is it me or do the staff seem really anxious all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Yeah, and they moved people away from keeping all the lines sorted... Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Huh? They're right. All of the staff seems to be scrambling around for some reason now...)

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: They're running really late now, aren't they? Our line hasn't moved for ages.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Everything's okay, right? I mean, things are running a little late...)

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <To all guests and visitors.>

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <We regret to inform you that we are experiencing some trouble at the meet-and-greet venue due to strong winds.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <No incidents have been reported as of yet, but if these winds persist, the possibility of an accident occurring will only increase.>

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <Unfortunately, we have no choice but to cancel today's meet-and-greet event.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Noooo! The meet and greet's being canceled?!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: But I waited so long...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, it's them!
It's all of ASRUN...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I really hope Haruka's okay...
She must be so torn up about this event getting canceled...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Thank you all so much for coming out to see us today...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I really regret not being able to see you all after traveling all this way... I'm so sorry.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <You must've all waited such so long and took this time out of your busy schedules to be here today...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It's not your fault, Haruka!
You can't control the wind and weather!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Today didn't go as planned, but I'll come back again and again! I'll do anything to see that smile of yours!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Yeah! We're happy as long as we get to see your faces!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Thank you so much...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Today's event did end up getting canceled, but I believe we'll get another chance to see each other.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <So until then, we'll be waiting!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll be there...!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: ASRUN's the best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (*Sob*... It's sad that it got canceled...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But Haruka's just that amazing!
Even though everyone was so disappointed, she was there to cheer us all up...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But that's only natural...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka's probably disappointed the most... She won't get to meet any of her fans.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I wish there was something I could do for her. I wish I could cheer her up somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <Thank you for visiting today. We deeply regret and apologize for what has happened. With regards to the next meet and greet...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I still remember the expression on Haruka's face that time...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Everyone was looking forward to meeting her, and she seemed so sad about disappointing them...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I understand why she feels the way she does about not showing them the other side of the stage.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I feel like our fans would be saddened even more if they saw that their favorite idols were having trouble putting on events...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (At least, that's what I felt that time...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that the fan who sent us that offer to help us did so because they feel the same way...)
